lead_raw_text:
The structure of Yb2TiAu crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 16-atom unit cell (Yb8Ti4Au4) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows each Au center has eight Yb neighbors, each Ti center has eight neighbors (four Au and four Ti), and each Yb center has ten neighbors (four Au and six Ti). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates Au–Ti, Au–Yb, and Ti–Yb polyhedra exhibit corner, edge, and face sharing, while Yb–Yb pairs show corner and face sharing.
